'''T4-9K Excavator''' was an [[Isotope-5 droid]] produced at some point during the [[Galactic War]]. By [[3630 BBY]] it was used by renegade Sith Lords [[Adacin]] and [[Zanisk]] to guard the base they set in the former [[Separatist stronghold]] on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]]. When the [[Eternal Alliance]] forces attacked the base, T4-9K Excavator was deployed to stop them, but was destroyed.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
T4-9K Excavator appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' as a mini-boss during the "Inferno" Uprising.
